patterns.note: Asymmetrical two-column content blocks, with descriptive text on the left and visual elements (images, grids) on the right, creating a balanced yet dynamic page structure.
A fixed header (logo and navigation) and footer (copyright and tagline) persist at the top and bottom of the viewport, framing the main scrollable content.
Consistent use of a single, clean sans-serif typeface with clear hierarchy established through size and weight, complemented by frequent use of uppercase for labels and navigation items.
A high-contrast monochrome palette of off-white background and very dark text, accented by a deep, abstract blue graphic in the hero section.
A large, abstract pixelated blue graphic in the hero section scrolls with a subtle parallax effect, appearing to move independently of the main content flow, while the main content scrolls smoothly.

Content sections are clearly delineated by large, left-aligned headings and generous vertical whitespace, often pairing a textual description with a visual grid of related items (e.g., team photos, company logos).

technique_notes: Implement a smooth scrolling experience for the main content area, likely leveraging a library like locomotive-scroll for enhanced scroll physics.
Create a fixed header and footer that remain visible at the top and bottom of the viewport, respectively, while the central page content scrolls underneath them.
Design the hero section with a large, abstract background graphic that scrolls at a slightly different rate than the foreground text content, creating a subtle parallax effect.

design_tokens.type_scale: Headings are moderately larger than body text (~1.5-2x body), with smaller uppercase labels (~0.8x body) used for section categories and navigation.

standout: The site's distinctive use of a large, abstract, pixelated blue graphic in the hero section, which subtly shifts with scroll, combined with a minimalist, asymmetrical layout and a fixed header/footer, creates a unique, almost editorial and sophisticated feel for a venture capital firm. The visual framing of content by the fixed header and footer is particularly elegant.
